integrity: The proof establishes all-prime Cartier ranks. The maximal class p=-1 mod14 and superspecial-minimal-automorphism corollary are already implied by previous published theorems and are credited as such; the remaining full nonmaximal rank chains are the proposed novel result.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the genus-three Dickson degree-seven model in odd characteristic except seven; automorphism statement relies on an earlier theorem and requires p>13; independent validation and historical priority review remain open.
title: Complete Cartier rank profiles for the genus-three Dickson–Chebyshev quotient
